Data files of the Bangladesh surveys

Source: R/data.R
bdhs_datasets.Rd

Catalogue of every data file the DHS Program distributes for Bangladesh: each recode (IR, KR, BR, HR, PR, ...) of each survey in each format, plus the SPA, BMMS and GPS files. bdhs uses it to recognise files you have downloaded and to know which recodes exist for a round.

Usage

bdhs_datasets

Format

A tibble with 441 rows (one per file) and 14 columns:

survey_id

DHS survey identifier (see bdhs_surveys).

survey_type

"DHS", "SPA" or "OTH".

survey_year

Survey year.

file_name

Name of the zip file as distributed, e.g. "BDIR7RFL.ZIP".

file_stem

Upper-case file name without extension, e.g. "BDIR7RFL".

file_type_code

Two-letter recode/file type code (characters 3-4 of the name): IR women, KR children under 5, BR births, HR households, PR household members, MR men, CR couples, GR/NR pregnancies (2022), WI wealth index and HW height/weight (early rounds), FW fieldworkers, SQ service availability, VA verbal autopsy, HH/IQ BMMS household and individual, FC/PV/SL/CO SPA facility, provider, staff listing and community, GE/GC GPS coordinates and geospatial covariates.

file_type

File type as described by the DHS Program.

recode_version

Two-character version code (characters 5-6).

format_code

File format code (characters 7-8): "DT" Stata, "FL" flat ASCII, "SD" SAS, "SV" SPSS; NA for files whose name has no format code.

file_format

File format as described by the DHS Program.

spa_variant

For SPA files, "SP" or "SR" (characters 9-10); otherwise NA.

dataset_type

"Survey Datasets", "SPA Datasets" or "GPS Datasets".

file_size

Size of the zip file in bytes.

last_modified

Date the file was last modified by the DHS Program.

Source

The DHS Program Indicator Data API, datasets endpoint, https://api.dhsprogram.com, retrieved 2026-10-26.

Details

The files themselves are not included: the DHS Program licenses microdata to registered users only.

See also

bdhs_surveys, bdhs_recodes(), bdhs_import().

Examples

# Stata files of the 2022 BDHS
bdhs_datasets[bdhs_datasets$survey_id == "BD2022DHS" &
  bdhs_datasets$format_code %in% "DT", c("file_name", "file_type")]
#> # A tibble: 9 × 2
#>   file_name    file_type                          
#>   <chr>        <chr>                              
#> 1 BDBR81DT.ZIP Births Recode                      
#> 2 BDFW81DT.ZIP Fieldworker Questionnaire          
#> 3 BDGR81DT.ZIP Pregnancies Recode                 
#> 4 BDHR81DT.ZIP Household Recode                   
#> 5 BDIR81DT.ZIP Individual Recode                  
#> 6 BDKR81DT.ZIP Children's Recode                  
#> 7 BDNR81DT.ZIP Pregnancy and Postnatal Care Recode
#> 8 BDPR81DT.ZIP Household Member Recode            
#> 9 BDVA81DT.ZIP Verbal Autopsy
